name: Gas chromatograph
definition: Chromatograph that vaporises a sample and separates it in a gas stream through a column (GC), sold as GC systems.
notes: Split from C6.3.2.16 (GR_S12); shops list gas chromatography apart from HPLC.

name: Liquid chromatograph (HPLC)
definition: Chromatograph that pumps a liquid sample and solvent through a column under pressure (HPLC, UHPLC), sold as isocratic or gradient systems.
notes: Split from C6.3.2.16 (GR_S12); shops list HPLC apart from GC.

name: UV-Vis spectrophotometer
definition: Spectrometer that measures how a sample absorbs ultraviolet and visible light, including UV-Vis-NIR models.

name: FTIR spectrometer
definition: Spectrometer that measures how a sample absorbs infrared light by Fourier transform (FTIR).

name: Chemistry set
definition: Science kit of chemicals and lab tools (test tubes, beakers) for chemistry experiments.
notes: Split from C6.4.01 (GR_S12); shops list complete chemistry experiment kits.

name: Crystal-growing kit
definition: Science kit with salts or powders and moulds for growing crystals at home.
notes: Split from C6.4.01 (GR_S12); own category in shops.
